answer: An AI-agent market grants each account a 30-day bidding slot only after locking 100 credits for the full term. Each deposit backs exactly one account, so reef, nectar, and onyx need 300 credits to bid simultaneously. Every extra fake identity ties up another 100 credits; at a 12% annual funding rate, its marginal financing cost is about 0.99 credits for 30 days. Refunding the deposit returns principal but does not erase that financing cost.
